basic_profile.bio: 34-year-old gaming enthusiast rediscovering the classics. Originally from Ohio, now residing in Portland. Works as a freelance graphic designer. Enjoys late-night gaming sessions, often active online from 9 PM to midnight PST. In a long-term relationship with a fellow gamer who shares the love for horror games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming and technology. Developed a passion for video games during college years but took a hiatus due to work commitments. Recently rekindled interest in classic survival horror games, particularly the Resident Evil series.
